localBiteReport: The inshore bite around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay is shaping up to be one of the best of the year as of the week of September 18–24, 2026. Redfish are the headline target, with both slot fish and oversized bulls biting well around bridges, jetties, and other structure — the outgoing tide has been especially productive, and live croakers and scaled sardines are the go-to baits. Flounder and speckled trout are also actively feeding as bait schools have become much easier to locate throughout the bay system. Water temperature in the bay is currently 86°F. Guides are noting this feels like a true early-fall transition, with fish responding reliably once moving water triggers the feed.
